column1: # Relocation map of recipe/relocate.py (recipe RELOCATE_NULLNESS_FACTS_PLUGIN v1). Donor: hsoliwal/com.synexia, lineage commit 982689e16763e54b01632407d64846fbea5719b6 (2026-11-01, "feat(compiler): materialize exact recipe-owned opt-in javac nullness plugin result"), an ancestor of develop ca1aafc4d94f9dd1ee288226dcca070cc60991c9 and the last commit at which the plugin, the flow lattice, the javac bridge and the proofs all sit at their live paths with the blobs the donor crate's qualification/verify.sh seals (plugin e06512091f03, flow 347ba86620ca, bridge 2045b84846cf). The develop live tree keeps only the plugin; the lattice and the bridge survive there as retained variants of PR 14877 (RETAINED rows, read at --develop-rev), where the bridge is the pre-linear predecessor 8553ed5abdf3 (recursive transfer, superseded by ed6eb1ca42e "perf(compiler): materialize source-sealed linear Boolean CFG transfer").

# FILE rows: donor Java path (donor repository root) -> target path (this module root). FIXTURE rows: copied byte for byte (LF-normalized only). SERVICE rows: a ServiceLoader descriptor, each line mapped as a fully qualified type name. PACKAGE rows: donor package -> target package. TYPE rows: donor type -> target type (identity when the donor name already follows M3 naming). EXTERNAL rows: third-party packages kept as they are (none here: java.base, java.compiler and jdk.compiler only). PROSE rows: regex -> replacement applied to whole comment lines (the product-name rules of make/m3/tooling/jdk-naming/NAMING_RULES.tsv, so that jdk_naming.py is a fixed point over the output). RETAINED rows: donor path -> retained-variant path on develop (pinned in PROVENANCE.tsv next to the lineage blob).

the plugin (-Xplugin:M3NullnessFacts): TaskListener on ANALYZE, TreePathScanner over methods and if statements, one stderr M3_NULLNESS_FACT row per refining guard; no tree or bytecode mutation; identity-keyed array hash table of reported units

fail-closed bridge from the attributed Tree API to the lattice: pure null tests, instanceof, literals, negation, parentheses, short-circuit operators; linear single-traversal Boolean transfer (Edges record), bounded 96 nodes / 12 operators / 2,000,000 words
lattice oracle: 100 slots, contradictory guards, truth table across packing boundaries, 4,000 seeded joins (associativity, commutativity, idempotence, unreachable identity)
real javac attributed-tree oracle: 22 guards (benign forms, field/callback/assignment/method-call decoys, tautologies, literals), both edges, both slots
generated guard matrix: 222 guards evaluated against Java semantics over null/String/Object values, budget refusals, large-fact-array refusal
the donor plugin fixture: two top-level classes, three pure guards (two in Sample, one in Sibling), method-call guard and code-looking string/text-block decoys refused
